# Instead of:
# df_joined <- inner_join(serum, urine, by = "Day") %>% mutate(urine_lead = lead(urine))

# Correct approach:
# Join urine at day + 1 directly or perform lead before filtering to serum day range:
urine_lagged <- urine %>% mutate(Day = Day - 1)
df_joined <- inner_join(serum, urine_lagged, by = "Day")
